scripts.build: sh -ec 'echo "Validating CPI artifacts..."; FILE=$(find iflows -name "*.zip" | sort -V | tail -1); test -n "$FILE"; BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); echo "Processing $FILE"; unzip -t "$FILE"; mkdir -p dist; cp "$FILE" "dist/$BASENAME"; NEXUS_USER="$nexus_usr"; NEXUS_PASS="${nexus_psw:-$nexus_password}"; echo "nexus_usr set? ${NEXUS_USER:+yes}"; echo "nexus password set? ${NEXUS_PASS:+yes}"; echo "Uploading to Nexus..."; test -n "$NEXUS_USER"; test -n "$NEXUS_PASS"; test -n "$ARTIFACT_URL"; curl --fail --show-error --silent -u "$NEXUS_USER:$NEXUS_PASS" -T "dist/$BASENAME" "$ARTIFACT_URL/$BASENAME"; echo "Uploaded successfully"'
